prompt.text:
Implement an exhaustive exhibit-tour analyzer in `solution.rs` using only the standard library.

Public API:
- `pub struct Passage { pub from: String, pub to: String, pub minutes: u64 }`
- `pub struct Tour { pub rooms: Vec<String>, pub minutes: u64 }`
- `pub enum TourError { EmptyRoom, SelfPassage, DuplicatePassage, CostOverflow }`
- `pub fn analyze_tours(passages: &[Passage]) -> Result<Vec<Tour>, TourError>`.

Passages are undirected. Room names are exact and case-sensitive. Reject an empty endpoint, a passage from a room to itself, or a repeated unordered room pair; validation errors must follow input order. A tour visits every distinct room exactly once and may use only listed passages between consecutive rooms. Return every such oriented tour: a tour and its reverse are separate unless they are identical. Sort results lexicographically by their `rooms` vectors. Use checked addition and return `CostOverflow` if any otherwise-valid tour cost overflows `u64`. With no passages there are no known rooms, so return an empty vector. A single distinct room cannot arise from valid input. Inputs must not be mutated. Derive `Clone`, `Debug`, `PartialEq`, and `Eq` for public types. Do not include `main`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
